clue.text: Flags in one part of the kingdom

definitions.meaning: to flag is to droop or tire, as a plant does without water
The standard short form of Wiltshire, an English county in the United Kingdom

explanation.surface: Banners are flown in one region of the realm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flags' looks like banners, but it is the verb meaning to droop. Wiltshire is a county in south-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are synonyms here: a drooping plant flags, and a county abbreviation names one region of the UK.

clue.text: Team labouring to produce Anglican anthem?

parts.note: an anthem is a piece of music, a work
Anglican means for CE, belonging to the Church of England, abbreviated CE

explanation.surface: Workers toil to create a hymn for the Church of England.
explanation.walkthrough: An Anglican anthem is a work for the CE: 'Anglican' gives FOR CE, the Church of England.
explanation.definitionFit: A workforce is the body of people employed on a job, so a team doing labour.

clue.text: Brief RAF man, held in reserve endlessly, not saying much

parts.note: LAC is the short form of Leading Aircraftman, a rank in the Royal Air Force

indicators.note: endlessly means without an end, so the last letter is removed

parts.note: something kept on ice is held in reserve for later

explanation.surface: A short airman, kept back to the end, stays quiet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' takes the final E off ON ICE, giving ONIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Laconic means using very few words, which is a synonym of saying little.

clue.text: Denizen of deep looks good in water

indicators.note: in places the good piece inside the water piece

parts.note: the sea is a body of water
PI, short for pious, means good in crossword use

explanation.surface: A creature of the ocean appears well-behaved in the water.
explanation.walkthrough: PI (pious) is the common crossword shorthand for good.
explanation.definitionFit: Sepia is the cuttlefish, a sea creature famous for its ink, so a dweller in the deep sea.

clue.text: Before summer, advertise poisonous creeper

indicators.note: the word before signals that the advertise piece is placed ahead of the summer piece

parts.note: to puff something is to promote or hype it
a summer is one who sums, i.e. one who adds up figures

explanation.surface: Ahead of the warm season, promote a venomous crawling thing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'summer' is not the season but one who sums or adds up; 'Before' tells you the advertise piece comes first, though the clue names it second.
explanation.definitionFit: The puff adder is a venomous African snake, and a snake creeps along the ground, hence a poisonous creeper.

clue.text: Looking amazed as cartoon character has daughter

parts.note: Popeye is the spinach-eating sailor of comic strips and cartoons
D is the abbreviation for daughter in genealogies

explanation.surface: A cartoon sailor gapes in surprise because he has a daughter.
explanation.definitionFit: Pop-eyed means with bulging eyes, an idiom for looking astonished.

clue.text: How to recognise cat, not Siamese, in the distance

parts.note: a cat is recognised by its coat, its fur
Siamese cats have short coats, so a cat not of that breed may have long hair

explanation.surface: A guide to telling a cat breed apart, seen from far off.
explanation.walkthrough: A long-haired cat is told by its long fur, unlike the short-coated Siamese.
explanation.definitionFit: A furlong is a unit of distance, an eighth of a mile, used in horse racing.

clue.text: Notice about lock being written down

indicators.note: about means around, so the notice piece goes around the lock piece

parts.note: an ad is a notice advertising something
a mortise lock is set into a door, so mortise can stand for lock

explanation.surface: A sign about a door lock being recorded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'written down' looks like recorded, but it is the accounting sense of reduced.
explanation.definitionFit: A debt or asset that is amortised is reduced in value over time, i.e. written down in the accounts.

clue.text: Rubbish found in valley, like certain leaves

indicators.note: found in means placed within, so the rubbish piece goes inside the valley piece

parts.note: a dene is a small wooded valley
tat is cheap rubbish or junk

explanation.surface: Junk turns up in a dell, as do some fallen leaves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'found in' is the container signal; DENE is a mainly northern English word for a narrow wooded valley.
explanation.definitionFit: Dentate means toothed, describing leaves with jagged edges like a holly or nettle leaf.

clue.text: Successfully resist pressure to join in dance

indicators.note: to join in means to take part within, so the pressure letter enters the dance piece

parts.note: a reel is a lively Scottish dance
P is the abbreviation for pressure in physics

explanation.surface: Fend off urging to take part in a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to join in' puts P inside REEL.
explanation.definitionFit: To repel an attack is to drive it back, which means resisting it successfully.

clue.text: More ready to eat, devouring mushroom, a thin basis for dish

indicators.note: devouring means swallowing up, so the riper piece takes the other letters inside itself

parts.note: fruit that is more ready to eat is riper
a cep is a type of edible mushroom, the porcino

explanation.surface: Fruit that has ripened further, eaten along with a mushroom, forms a thin layer under food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'devouring' is the container signal: the riper word swallows the mushroom and the A, splitting after its second letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Edible rice paper is used as a thin base under macaroons and other baked dishes.

clue.text: Confess leader must abandon contrary directions

indicators.note: the leader is the first letter, which must leave the phrase, so its opening letter is removed

parts.note: down and up are opposite directions

explanation.surface: Admit that the chief has to give up opposing courses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader must abandon' removes the D at the front of DOWN UP.
explanation.definitionFit: To own up is an idiom meaning to admit a fault, which is what one does on confessing.

clue.text: Get a kick out of dream team playing this?

definitions.text: Get a kick out of dream team playing this?

parts.words: Get a kick out of dream team playing this?
parts.note: reads as enjoying watching an ideal side, but describes a game where fans pick an imaginary squad of real players and score points from their matches

explanation.walkthrough: 'kick' hints at both pleasure and booting a ball, and 'dream team' is literally an imagined side.
explanation.definitionFit: In this game players choose an imaginary dream side of real footballers and enjoy points from their kicks.

clue.text: Direct English translation read out

indicators.note: a translation turns words into new form, signalling that these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A straight rendering into English was spoken aloud.
explanation.walkthrough: 'translation' rearranges DIRECT plus E.
explanation.definitionFit: To recite is to say a text aloud from memory or a page, so recited is a synonym of read out.

clue.text: Sheet disturbed in nap ritual

indicators.note: disturbed means upset or jumbled, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A bedsheet gets disturbed during a bedtime routine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' rearranges NAP RITUAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A tarpaulin is a large waterproof sheet used to cover things outdoors.

clue.text: When king has entered, receives seals

indicators.note: entered means gone inside, so the When and king pieces are placed inside the receives piece

parts.note: to receive is to get, so receives means gets
as can mean when, as in 'as he left'
K is the abbreviation for king in chess

explanation.surface: Once the monarch has come in, he accepts official stamps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has entered' is the container signal, and 'seals' wants to be the animals but means rings that close joints.
explanation.definitionFit: Gaskets are rings or sheets that seal joints between machine parts, so they are seals.

clue.text: One should keep running for the whole race, all the time

definitions.text: One should keep running for the whole race, all the time

parts.words: One should keep running for the whole race, all the time
parts.note: reads like an athlete who must not stop, but describes a timing device left going throughout a race to time it

explanation.walkthrough: 'keep running' suggests a runner, but it is a device that runs while it measures 'all the time' taken.
explanation.definitionFit: A timer used by race officials runs from start to finish, measuring the whole time elapsed.

clue.text: Some blades, part of grass

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A few leaves form a portion of the lawn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blades' fits the grass picture neatly, but the answer sits across 'blades, part of'.
explanation.definitionFit: Esparto is a tough Spanish and North African grass used for paper and rope.

clue.text: Ecstasy in old forbidden city, looking where one shouldn't

indicators.note: in places the Ecstasy letter inside the city piece

parts.note: Peking is the old name of Beijing, home of the Forbidden City
E is slang for the drug Ecstasy

explanation.surface: Drugs found in the old forbidden city, glimpsed by someone snooping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'forbidden city' sets up Beijing's palace; the old spelling is Peking.
explanation.definitionFit: Peeking means taking a sly look, often at something one is not supposed to see.

clue.text: Pulled up to interrupt people making maps further ahead

indicators.note: to interrupt is to break into, so the reversed piece goes inside the mapmakers piece

parts.note: OS is the Ordnance Survey, Britain's national mapping agency

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read upwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: drawn means pulled, as a cart is drawn

explanation.surface: Stopped short to break into the work of cartographers further along.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' is the reversal signal in a down clue and 'to interrupt' the container signal; the Ordnance Survey makes Britain's official maps.
explanation.definitionFit: Onwards means forward or further along, a synonym of further ahead.

clue.text: Spaniard covered up an attempt to seize sovereign

parts.note: covered up means concealed, i.e. hid

indicators.note: to seize is to grab hold of, so the attempt piece wraps around the sovereign piece

parts.note: a go is an attempt, so an attempt is a go
a sovereign is a pound coin, and L is the abbreviation for pound

explanation.surface: A man from Spain concealed a bid to grab the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to seize' puts L inside A GO. The sovereign was an old British gold coin worth one pound, and L (from Latin libra) stands for pound.
explanation.definitionFit: A hidalgo is a member of the lower Spanish nobility, so a type of Spaniard.

clue.text: What Boleyn lost, cut by edge where chopper came down

indicators.note: cut by means split open by another piece, so the edge piece goes inside the Boleyn piece

parts.note: Anne Boleyn, wife of Henry VIII, was beheaded, so she lost her head
a lip is an edge or rim

explanation.surface: Anne Boleyn's lost head, severed by an edge where the axe fell.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface makes the chopper an axe; in the definition it is a helicopter.
explanation.definitionFit: A helipad is a landing pad for helicopters, slangily choppers, so a place where one lands.

clue.text: Connection is leaking badly

indicators.note: badly means in a poor way, so the letters are put in a different order

explanation.surface: A joint is leaking badly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' rearranges LEAKING.
explanation.definitionFit: A linkage is a link or connection between things.

clue.text: Modern trends in the novel

definitions.meaning: current fashions and habits of present-day life
a satirical novel by Anthony Trollope, published in 1875

explanation.surface: Contemporary fashions appear in the book.
explanation.walkthrough: A double definition: a phrase for present-day habits, and the title of Trollope's novel about Victorian greed.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes current habits of living, and is also the title of Trollope's famous satire.

clue.text: In principle in China one finds extremely sagacious poet

indicators.note: In means inside, so the extreme letters go inside the principle piece

parts.note: the Tao is the guiding principle in Chinese philosophy

indicators.note: extremely takes the first and last letters, the extremes, of sagacious

explanation.surface: In a Chinese principle one finds a very wise poet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' gives the first and last letters of sagacious, S and S.
explanation.definitionFit: Torquato Tasso was a 16th-century Italian poet, author of Jerusalem Delivered.

clue.text: Nitrogen-filled meat that can be bought

indicators.note: filled means having something put inside, so nitrogen goes into the meat piece

parts.note: veal is calf meat
N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen

explanation.surface: Meat injected with nitrogen is up for sale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'filled' puts N inside VEAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Venal describes someone open to bribery, i.e. whose loyalty can be purchased.

clue.text: Refuse to add signature at first to legal document

indicators.note: at first takes only the opening letter of signature

parts.note: a will is a legal document setting out what happens to an estate

explanation.surface: Decline to sign a legal paper first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refuse' looks like the verb to decline, but it is the noun: waste.
explanation.definitionFit: Swill is kitchen waste fed to pigs, so it is refuse in the sense of rubbish.

clue.text: Sorry salesman's run away from competitor

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative; the 's stands for has

indicators.note: away from means taken off, so the run letter leaves the competitor piece

parts.note: an entrant is one who enters a competition
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: An apologetic sales rep has fled from a rival.
explanation.walkthrough: 'away from' removes R (run) from ENTRANT, leaving ENTANT.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone repentant feels regret for a wrong, which is what being sorry means.

clue.text: Ignored as arrangement is fixed up

indicators.note: an arrangement puts things in a new order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An overlooked plan is sorted out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arrangement' rearranges IGNORED AS.
explanation.definitionFit: Something organised has been arranged or sorted out, which is what fixed up means.

clue.text: Old medical attendant, one good at sponging

definitions.meaning: an archaic word for a physician or healer
a parasite who lives off others, like the bloodsucking worm

explanation.surface: An old doctor who is good at cadging.
explanation.walkthrough: A double definition: the old word for a doctor, and someone who scrounges off others.
explanation.definitionFit: In old usage the word meant a doctor, and today it describes a freeloader who clings to others.
